title: neoporteria subgibbosa f. minor
intro: Neoporteria subgibbosa f. minor, commonly known as a type of cactus, is a medicinal plant species in the Echinocereus genus. This plant is used for its health benefits, which include treating wounds, inflammation, and skin conditions due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Neoporteria subgibbosa f. minor include analgesic and antiseptic effects, making it a potential treatment for pain and infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which have been identified through various studies.
